title: Austin Funds New Affordable Housing Projects
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors Regular Meeting
summary:
*   Approved $460,000 to create 37 new affordable homes for purchase in South Austin (District 2).
*   Greenlit funding for 45 supportive housing units on Menchaca Road (District 5) for residents at 30-50% median family income.
*   These projects aim to boost accessible housing options for low-income residents across Austin.
